description: Find gift cards by country, brand or both (at least one), e.g. country US and query amazon. Returns id, name, brand, country, currency and the lowest price in EUR (from_eur). Cards are region locked: a card works only with accounts in its own country.

country.description: Two-letter ISO code of the card's country, e.g. US

query.description: Brand or card name, e.g. amazon

name: search_giftcards
title: Search gift cards
